people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Jacob boiled stew. Esau came in from the field, and he was famished.
translations.bsb: One day, while Jacob was cooking some stew, Esau came in from the field and was famished.
translations.kjv: And Jacob sod pottage: and Esau came from the field, and he was faint:
translations.asv: And Jacob boiled pottage. And Esau came in from the field, and he was faint.
